defs.def: to become stronger; to make sb/sth stronger 加强；增强；巩固

ex.s: While gendering a product may be good marketing, it may also strengthen outdated or harmful ideas about power and identity.
ex.t: 虽然给产品赋予性别可能是好的营销，但也可能强化关于权力和身份的过时或有害观念。

ex.s: Comparing Ourselves with Others Can Strengthen Family Ties
ex.t: 将我们自己与他人相比较可以加强家庭联系

ex.s: This form of remembered contact with a book can accompany us during a lifetime and continue to strengthen and shape us.
ex.t: 这种带着记忆的与书接触的方式可以陪伴我们一生，并持续地强化和塑造我们。

ex.s: These abilities are strengthened by our capacity for language, which allows social practices to develop in extremely unobvious ways.
ex.t: 这些能力因我们的语言能力而加强，语言能力让社会实践能以极其不明显的方式发展。

ex.s: It gives us an opportunity to learn from another person’s experience and it can shape, strengthen or challenge our opinions and values.
ex.t: 它给了我们一个从他人经历中学习的机会，并且能够塑造、强化或挑战我们的观点和价值观。

ex.s: It strengthened her love for school.
ex.t: 加强了她对学校的热爱。

ex.s: The likables’ plays-well-with-others qualities strengthen schoolyard friendships, jump-start interpersonal skills and, when tapped early, are employed ever after in life and work.
ex.t: 讨人喜欢的那种"善于与人相处"的品质加强了校园友谊，启动了人际交往技能，如果及早发掘，将在以后的生活和工作中一直发挥作用。

ex.s: Data can strengthen giants’ controlling position.
ex.t: 数据可以加强巨头的控制地位。

ex.s: One idea is that sleep helps us strengthen new memories.
ex.t: 同样地，当人们几天不睡觉时，他们会生病。

ex.s: Another way of strengthening an apology is by using and stressing adverbs: I'm really sorry, I'm so sorry.
ex.t: 加强道歉的另一种方式是使用并强调副词：我真的很抱歉，我非常抱歉。

ex.s: This develops your core muscles and strengthens your lower back.
ex.t: 这能锻炼你的核心肌肉，强化你的下背部。

ex.s: It strengthened people's long held idea of the great white shark as a dangerous animal.People have always been scared of sharks, but Jaws made things worse.
ex.t: 这强化了人们长期以来认为大白鲨是危险动物的看法。人们一直害怕鲨鱼，但《大白鲨》让情况变得更糟。

ex.s: Given that the theme of the Expo was to promote cultural exchange and strengthen mutual cooperation between the countries along the Silk Road, Dunhuang was the ideal place.
ex.t: 鉴于世博会的主题是促进文化交流和加强丝绸之路沿线国家之间的相互合作，敦煌是理想之地。

ex.s: They have great facilities and outstanding professors, helping to educate young people who will contribute to the economy and further strengthen our country.
ex.t: 他们拥有一流的设施和杰出的教授，帮助教育那些将为经济做出贡献并进一步巩固我们国家的年轻人。
